_: Gates for tests/charlab.mjs (docs/characters.md, Gates). Ratchet tighter only; loosening needs a decision recorded there. Metres, seconds, radians. teleport: hip and ankles per 120 Hz frame; teleportHand: the hands (a swing or a throw moves them 20 cm a frame; the batter's are exempt from the backlift's end to the follow-through). Teleports are breaks in the motion (distance from where the previous step's velocity puts the joint); jumps under a camera cut of the game (labGameView) are allowed and kept as resetJump. releaseHand: the bowler's hands from 0.15 s before the release to 0.08 s after it, at most this times the ball's release speed per frame (a hand faster than the ball it lets go of is a snap; never below teleportHand). No slip while sliding (act 5). tris: the scene without the crowd (counted apart as crowd).
